subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should maintainers rebase the remaining source-builder move optimization onto current main, or close this branch as superseded by current gateway packaging?
rationale: Current main already includes the safety and `dontFixup` pieces, but the remaining install-semantic change is compatibility-sensitive, the PR is member-authored, and the branch conflicts with newer packaging structure.

options.title: Rebase narrowly
options.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying any still-wanted move optimization.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: If the source-builder move optimization is no longer worth carrying after the npm-shrinkwrap default path, close the stale branch manually.

recommendation.title: Rebase narrowly
recommendation.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying any still-wanted move optimization.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent gateway packaging history and authored the branch-trimming commit that left this as a narrow packaging decision.
